notes:
Lead origin: inbound self-serve signup from dev blog post.

Key context: KiteBay builds an in-editor code assistant + semantic repo search for small engineering teams. CTO (Eve Park) said: "we want a drop-in hosted API — no infra right now, public cloud only".

Procurement pain: startup credit is about to expire; they want a 30-day extension and a small startup discount (10-20%) if they convert to CC billing. They do have occasional need for invoice (seed round bookkeeping) but invoice volume will be tiny (<$1k/mo) initially. Primary ask: clear path to pay by card today vs PO/invoice next quarter.

Performance & scale: POC target latency 80-200ms token-service for completions, embeddings QPS ~25, bursts to 75/min. Cost sensitivity: high — will prioritize cheaper smaller models and caching/embeddings to reduce calls.

Security/compliance: SSO via Google SSO preferred; audit logs desirable but not blocker. Data residency: US only for now.
